description: Jet 4 MDB (copy of r-cat-1-mdb-empty.mdb) empty table T with no AutoNumber column (ID LONG PK, K LONG unique, S TEXT(50)) so row 1 takes a new data page. Src has row 1 (ID 10, K 11) accepted and row 2 (ID 11, K 11) duplicating row 1 on UK. INSERT INTO T SELECT ... ORDER BY N with dbFailOnError fails 3022 on row 2 by UK. Keeps pages 0-1 and 19+ after setup, after statement (1500 ms pause), and after follow-up INSERT; reads TableDef.RecordCount and rows.
retentionNote: mkb7: whole-file nativeRead at each observeFiles point including after-close
